text:
leah: Opening PR to consolidate Java + Rust snippets in Optimize toolkit. goal: single canonical example per language, fix broken links, and reduce flakiness in expected outputs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5023
om: Nice. What broke the outputs?
leah: Short-sequence tokenizer differences produced trailing-space diffs on the sample outputs. CI kept failing intermittently. I trimmed expected outputs to remove whitespace-sensitive lines and added a short note: "Outputs may vary slightly by tokenizer; tests check semantic lines only."
hiro: Good. Did you also update the Java SDK changes? there was a recent rename from BatchOpts to BatchConfig in v0.8.
leah: Yup — updated Java snippets to use BatchConfig builder: `BatchConfig.builder().maxBatchTokens(512).latencyTargetMs(150).build()` and added a migration callout in /optimize/migration.md. Also added a tiny Rust example showing BatchConfig serde map for folks using the Rust SDK.
om: Any compatibility helpers for teams on v0.7?
leah: I added an optional mapping snippet but kept it off the mainline examples. For Java: `if (legacyBatchSize != null) batchConfig = BatchConfig.builder().maxBatchTokens(legacyBatchSize*8).build();` with a short comment. For Rust: a one-liner mapping in the migration section.
hiro: CI reported a dead link to /optimize/quant-presets/legacy-q6 in one of the examples earlier. fixed?
leah: Fixed all dead links and added a redirect from the old preset URL to the new quant-profiles page. Also clarified the quant-profile section: we explain why q6_deprecated was removed (instability on short sequences) and recommend q4 for short-seq low-latency use cases.
docs-bot: CI: Docs lint flagged a wide table in quant rationale.
leah: Resolved table width by switching to bullet list for rationale; pushed fix.
ci-bot: CI: deploy-preview 5023 build triggered 
om: Ran smoke tests against staging: Java and Rust snippets both compile/run. left a minor nit about import ordering in Java snippet.
leah: Fixed import order and rebased. Also added a short bench example in tools/example-scripts/compare_quant.sh (keeps outputs minimal to avoid flakiness).
hiro: Small doc nit: can we add a one-line diagram showing order: Tokenize -> Prefetch -> Batch -> Runtime so readers understand where quant profiles apply?
leah: Added one-line flow and a short sentence in prefetch.md.
docs-bot: deploy-preview: https://deploy-preview-5023--docs.redwood.ai/optimize/migration.html (staging)
ci-bot: CI: all checks passed 
leah: Thanks all. Plan to merge after 6h if no objections. Will backport only link fixes to the v0.7 branch.
om: :+1:
hiro: :+1: thanks for handling the flakiness.
leah: Merged. Will open a follow-up to further compress sample outputs if we see more flakiness.
